takeaway: Measure AFP, β-hCG, and LDH before and after orchidectomy. For stage I non-seminoma, surveillance is the path; one cycle of BEP is the strong adjuvant alternative when surveillance will not be followed [1].
clinicalQuestion: Which markers are required, and when is adjuvant BEP used in stage I non-seminoma?
background: EAU testicular cancer guideline, limited update April 2024 [1].
intervention: Orchidectomy, serial tumour markers, and risk-adapted adjuvant bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin.
comparator: Surveillance for clinical stage I non-seminoma.
primaryOutcome: Correct staging and a surveillance-first plan, with chemotherapy if surveillance is not realistic.
mainFindings: AFP, β-hCG, and LDH should be measured before and after orchidectomy and throughout follow-up. They are used for staging, risk stratification, monitoring treatment, and detecting relapse. Stage IS means that after orchidectomy the markers rise, stay elevated, or fail to fall as their half-lives predict, implying subclinical metastases; a contralateral tumour should also be excluded. For clinical stage I non-seminoma, one course of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin is a strong adjuvant alternative if the patient will not undergo or comply with surveillance. Abdominal contrast CT has a median sensitivity of 67% and specificity of 95% for staging. Pain, scrotal or abdominal, can delay the diagnosis of a usually painless mass [1].
clinicalMeaning: A falling marker that is still too high for its half-life is stage IS, not stage I. Adjuvant BEP is for the patient who will not be surveyed, not the default [1].
limitations: Radiotherapy doses for stage II seminoma appear in a figure with extraction artefacts, so they are not used as questions [1].
bottomLine: Three markers around orchidectomy. Surveillance for stage I non-seminoma, or one cycle of BEP if surveillance will not happen [1].
practiceImplication: Do not rely on abdominal CT alone: sensitivity is only 67% [1].
trustRationale: Current EAU guideline with a strong recommendation on adjuvant BEP.
quizFocusPoints: one cycle of BEP if no surveillance
whatNotToOverclaim: Do not teach two cycles of BEP as the 2024 strong recommendation; the sentence read is one course.
